update_classes.A_rename_metadata_only: no vector or graph change; not modeled here
update_classes.B_membership_change: one item leaves owner a and joins owner b: local HNSW delete plus insert, then both ancestor chains
update_classes.C_topology_MM: attribute DAG MOVE/MERGE changes ancestors of whole subtrees

note: Distance counts assume farthest-first portals and the current bridge loops. They exclude local HNSW delete/insert, reverse-bridge repair and allocation. A targeted implementation may fuse or cache work, so these are upper-bound style sizes of the current code paths, not achievable costs.
